title: Hauntology, Lost Futures and 80s Nostalgia
summary: A video essay explaining hauntology, Mark Fisher's idea of lost futures, and 80s nostalgia. It uses the Fallout games and other media as examples of a retro-futurism that mourns futures that never arrived.
why: Recommended as a clear introduction to hauntology and lost futures in discussions of Mark Fisher and cyberpunk.

quote.text: I think this guy does a great job of explaining it through the analogy of the Fallout videogame series
